title: Test aggregate per-frequency occupancy windows
description:
Scope: the per-frequency occupancy case group of the independent admission supplement in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/test/vectors/. Under the declared ordinary narrow-FHSS test basis, cover aggregate 400 ms occupancy in 20 seconds, not only a per-packet maximum. Specify partial overlaps, exact boundaries, rounding, future complete-emission fit and earliest release time using the source-backed interval contract. Keep other operating bases explicitly separate. Do not use the production duty tracker as the expected-value oracle or claim a channel count proves compliance.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse vectors.09 arithmetic and authority.06 interpretation; this leaf owns only concrete occupancy scenarios. The following language consumers must show actual no-TX behavior for the rejection cases.
acceptance_criteria: The independent ledger rejects the second of two 250 ms same-frequency emissions inside the applicable 20-second window. Exact 400 ms, one-unit excess, partial-overlap and window-release cases have exact integer outcomes and documented endpoint semantics. Prospective admission counts the complete proposed emission throughout the relevant window. Fixture/schema checks are deterministic, all cases appear in the supplement inventory, and no RF or authorization conclusion is inferred.
